extracted.intended_audience: students and researchers studying internet memes (media studies, writing, digital culture)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for conducting qualitative research on internet memes, focusing on understanding memetic content, the relationship between memes and power, and ethical considerations; presents and compares qualitative content analysis and critical discourse analysis that can be done with limited resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand memetic content and power relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: Study internet memes to better understand memetic content and the relationship between memes and power.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use meme analysis to reveal the values and ideologies promoted through social media content and to interrogate how memes participate in power dynamics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examine the relationship between culture and technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Use meme research to help better understand the relationship between culture and technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider how technological affordances, platform norms, and cultural contexts shape meme production, circulation, and interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use qualitative content analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply qualitative content analysis as a method for analyzing memes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This method is presented as practical for solo researchers with low resource requirements; it supports systematic coding and categorization of memetic elements and themes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use critical discourse analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply critical discourse analysis as a method for analyzing memes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This method foregrounds power, ideology, and language/discursive practices in memes; the guide describes its merits and how it can be used with minimal resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Match method to research aims and resource constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose between (or combine) methods based on their merits and the project's resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both qualitative content analysis and critical discourse analysis are described as feasible 'on your own' approaches; select the approach that best addresses your research questions and ethical constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address ethical issues in meme research
rubrics_metrics.description: Anticipate and approach ethical issues involved in meme research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide lays out ways to handle ethics—consider privacy, consent, potential harms to subjects or communities, attribution, and the public/private status of online content when designing and reporting research.
